fusions.name: Mooring Links
fusions.desc: Casts a length of links that deals 4 damage, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave its target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Anchor Cast
fusions.desc: Heaves an anchor at a target up to 7 tiles away for 13 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach. It stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it moving 25% slower for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Tow Line
fusions.desc: Ties a line to the ally who needs it most, restoring 3 health a second to them for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Slack Taken Up
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (21% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
